title: Automate all the things
content: Through automation, managing ClickHouse infrastructure becomes effortless. Utilizing public API keys, it enables easy setup, efficient scaling, and secure, consistent deployments.

title: Interactive SQL console
content: The fastest and easiest way to connect, explore and query your ClickHouse databases. Exclusively available to ClickHouse Cloud customers.

title: Secure. Verified compliant
content: ClickHouse Cloud is SOC 2 Type II compliant! Security, availability, processing integrity, and confidentiality processes all independently audited.

title: Pay as you go
content: Start building without managing cluster size or scale. We handle security, upgrades, and more. Pay only for what you use, ensuring optimal price/performance and low overhead.

title: Scale seamlessly
content: Forget about over-provisioning for peak usage and paying for unused capacity. ClickHouse seamlessly scales to meet demands and unpredictable workloads so you can focus on what really matters, right from the start.

title: Broad ecosystem
content: Use our ClickPipes integrations engine to ingest your data with ease. Bring your favorite data connectors, visualization tools, SQL and language clients with you.
